meta.title: The door | {{brand.name}} for hosts
meta.description: QR self check-in with no app to download, a searchable list, walk-ins you choose and door staff whose access ends with the night. Check-ins made without signal sync when you’re back online.
meta.socialDescription: Know who’s here in the first five minutes. The door on {{brand.name}}.

sections.title: Know who’s here in the first five minutes.
sections.lead: Guests scan in on their own phones, with no app to download. You see who’s in, who’s late and who’s new, let in the walk-ins you choose, and hand the door to a helper whose access ends with the night.

sections.title: However they arrive, they’re on the list.

items.title: Most guests scan in
items.body: A code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their number and they’re in.

items.title: No phone? You tick them off
items.body: Search the list by name and check them in yourself. A group booking checks in together, on one pass.

items.title: Turned up unbooked? You let them in
items.body: Add a walk-in in a few seconds, if you have room. They’re on the list for the follow-up too.

items.title: Booked somewhere else? Bring the list
items.body: Import a guest list from a CSV or Excel file. On Luma Plus, connect Luma and refresh to bring in its latest guest list.

sections.title: Checked in, and pointed to the right person.
sections.lead: After they check in, guests see their group, table or team, depending on your format. Then the phone goes back in the pocket.
ticks: Their group, seat, team or pod, depending on your format
A first hello, if you turn it on, so nobody stands at the door alone
First-timers flagged for you, so they get a proper hello

sections.title: Hand over the door, not your business.
sections.lead: Give a friend or a venue’s staff the door for one event. They can search the list and check people in, and that’s all. Their access ends when you say.
ticks: Door access for one event, with an end time you set
No access to your other events, your contacts or your money
Take access back at any time

sections.title: Basement bar? Check-ins still count.
sections.lead: If the signal drops while you’re checking people in, the check-ins are saved on your phone and sync when you’re back online. If two people checked in the same guest, {{brand.name}} shows you so you can sort it out.

rows.title: 4 check-ins waiting to sync
rows.detail: They’ll send when you’re back online.

sections.title: The list keeps working.
sections.lead: Who came and who didn’t goes into your guest records, so the people who showed up are the ones you thank and invite to the next one.

items.question: Do guests need to download anything?
items.answer: No. The code at the door opens your event in their phone’s browser. They confirm with their phone number.

items.question: What if someone’s phone is dead?
items.answer: Search their name and check them in yourself.

items.question: How do group bookings check in?
items.answer: A group booking is one pass for the whole party, so the group checks in together.

items.question: Can I take walk-ins?
items.answer: Yes, if you choose to. Add them at the door and they’re on the list like everyone else.

items.question: Can more than one person run the door?
items.answer: Yes. Give each helper door access for the event, on their own phone. If two of you check in the same guest, {{brand.name}} shows you so you can sort it out.

items.question: What happens with no signal?
items.answer: Check-ins made without signal are saved on the phone, and sync when you’re back online.

items.question: I sell tickets on Luma. Can I still use the door?
items.answer: Yes. If you’re on Luma Plus, connect your Luma account and refresh the guest list whenever you want the latest. Or import a guest list from a CSV or Excel file.
